outcome.interpretation_limit: The second record documented the implementation and restated its target hypothesis; it did not report another encounter with that limitation.

pressure_hypothesis.title: An implementation record that restates its target pressure inflates the recurrence count
pressure_hypothesis.basis: The live projection grouped both a pressure-gap record and its improvement record under one pressure identity, producing repeated-within-session even though only one pressure occurrence was reported.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Retain improvement records and their pressure link, but exclude a linked implementation record from pressure recurrence counts; count a later occurrence only when an independent observation records it.
not_measured: whether the same double-counting pattern affects other pressure hypotheses
whether a separate later operational observation shows the pressure again
whether the earlier incorrect recurrence label changed an agent decision

supporting_sources.observed_contract: Recurrence grouped every observation record carrying the hypothesis identity without excluding implementation-linked records.

not_measured: recurrence patterns across other campaigns and sessions
whether duplicate labels changed subsequent development activity
independent operational recurrence of the addressed session activity pressure
